title: Tasks

banner.title: Task management.
banner.body: To reassign a task or change its status you need two things. A manager role in your area, and a reason. Every change is recorded. You see only tasks in your area.

error: Couldn’t load tasks. Nothing was changed. Try again.

empty.title: No tasks in your scope
empty.body: Tasks appear here when assigned within your branch or sector. An empty list may mean none exist, or none are in your scope.

terminal: This task is terminal — no further transitions are possible.
readOnly: You can see this task but it is not yours to manage.
